metadata.description: German air-quality intelligence skills powered by the luftqualitaet-cli (Umweltbundesamt Air Data API)

plugins.name: luftqualitaet
plugins.description: Find the right air-quality monitoring station for a place, brief the current air-quality index for a station, and rank stations by annual pollutant levels or limit exceedances — all over the open, key-free Umweltbundesamt Air Data API via the luftqualitaet-cli.
